thread:
mia: Heads-up - nightly SAST flagged ~12 HIGHs in keystore-service and the CI runner shows intermittent KMS decrypt errors. Opening thread for triage. https://ci.redwood.example/keystore/nightly/3087 :eyes:
security-bot: Automated alert: SAST run 'nightly-keystore-v2' completed. 12 HIGH, 34 MED, 77 LOW. Link: https://scans.example/reports/3087.sha256
alok: Ugh. Can you paste the top 3 HIGH findings? quick snippets are fine.
jordan: Most likely FP on generated protos and the keystore wrapper. We've seen SAST flag missing null checks on generated code before. Worth running with skip-generated flag.
mia: Top 3 (masked):
```
1) crypto/keystore/manager.go: possible insecure random -> reviewed, uses crypto/rand but flagged by pattern match
2) crypto/keystore/handler.go: potential key exposure via log.Printf -> appears in error path, but needs evidence
3) internal/kms/client.go: retry loop swallows AccessDenied from KMS
```
sre-oncall: CI log shows KMS AccessDenied bursts around 03:12 UTC. From gha-runner logs: `ERROR KMS: Decrypt failed: PermissionDenied for serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
alok: That explains some findings - if KMS fails the code path logs more info, SAST picks up heuristics. We should confirm whether KMS perms actually changed or if there's a transient IAM token issue.
jordan: Quick repro: run `go test ./... -run TestKMS` with credentials of scanner SA and tail the logs. Also try SAST with `--exclude generated/` config.
security-bot: New incident ticket created: INC-2026-147 (keystore-sast-kms-flap). Owners: @mia, @sre-oncall. Priority: P2.
mia: Action plan proposal:
- step 1: SRE: validate scanner SA IAM bindings and rotation events (sre-oncall)
- step 2: Dev: run SAST with exclusions to estimate FPs (jordan)
- step 3: Security: bundle evidence for each HIGH and mark waivers where appropriate (mia)
- step 4: If KMS perms were changed, file RBAC rollback or ephemeral grant and attach audit log (alok)
Please ack and pick items. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: Taking step 1. Running `gcloud logging read "resource.type=cloud_function OR resource.type=cloud_run AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=scanner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --limit 50 --format json` to find recent role changes. Will paste results.

alok: I'll check IAM policy history: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-core --filter="bindings.members:scanner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --flatten=bindings` and check Cloud Audit Logs for SetIamPolicy events.
jordan: I'll run SAST locally with `sast-runner --skip-generated --config .sast-ci.yaml` and post a diff of findings. If >60% are excluded, we mark as FP candidate and create suppression PR.
mia: Also we need to preserve the evidence for compliance - do not redact logs until ticket review. Attach logs to INC-2026-147 and link in PRs.
security-bot: Evidence checklist: `logs/ci/*.log`, `sast-report.json`, `k8s/audit.log`, `gcp/audit.log` — attach to incident before 2026-03-23T12:00Z.
sre-oncall: Quick update: found a SetIamPolicy by infra-automation at 2026-03-21T22:07Z that removed `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` from scanner SA (looks like a deploy bug). Pinging infra-automation owner.
alok: If that matches, rollback or re-grant asap. We should document a safe premerge test: fail SAST on missing KMS outputs rather than logging secrets.
jordan: For the SAST false positives on generated code, proposing to add a CI step `sast-filter-gen` that removes findings under `*/generated/*` and requires manual review for suppressed ones. Low friction.
mia: Good. Two urgent asks: (1) SRE, please re-grant decrypter role or provide a temporary ephemeral grant with audit log. (2) Security, create suppression PR template and link to evidence in the incident.
sre-oncall: Re-grant in progress (using ephemeral grant flow). Will paste IAM change event once done.

sre-oncall: IAM change event: `SetIamPolicy` at 2026-03-22T03:18:02Z re-added roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter for scanner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com. Audit log: https://console.logs.example/entry/ABC123
jordan: Reran SAST after exclusions. Findings dropped to 3 HIGHs (all legitimate): I'll open PRs for fixes. Patch plan in PR description.
mia: Great. For compliance, will keep INC-2026-147 open until fix PRs merged and we have audit proof. Assigned owners: jordan -> PR fixes, alok -> audit log verification and RBAC doc update, mia -> suppression PR + evidence bundle. ETA EOD.
alok: I'll update RBAC runbook to include a preflight that checks scanner SA has `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` and aborts deploy if missing. I'll add that as a guard in infra-automation.
security-bot: Incident INC-2026-147 status changed to Investigating -> Mitigated. Updated at 2026-03-22T04:05Z.
mia: Thanks team. Postmortem notes: avoid logging raw decrypt errors, add guard for KMS permissions in CI, and add SAST suppression for generated code with explicit human review. Follow-up sync tomorrow at 10:00 UTC. :calendar:

jordan: ack. I'll post the PR links when ready. :+1:

sre-oncall: closing loop on grants; monitoring for recurrence.

mia: If anyone spots related failures in other services, ping INC-2026-147.
